findings.finding: Push trigger lists branches [main, arena/29806afc-korea2]. That session's PRs #14 and #15 are merged; the trigger still names the old branch.

Claims for arena/9e0420bd-korea2, arena/89b8d356-korea2, arena/652b0095-korea2 and arena-29806afc are still listed as active. Their branches still exist on origin. Their PRs are merged (#14/#15, #50/#61, #60/#63/#64) or closed unmerged (#7, which the owner closed as duplicate). The board was not updated; not re-claimed.
The official-host allowlist includes www.weather.gov and github.com. github.com is not an official NFL source, so the allowlist is looser than the stated official-source policy.

README reports '0 of 7 candidates' with 2 controls failing. skill-lab/data/strategies.json reports 16 tested and 0 qualified. tests/check_data.py reports '0 of 5 strategies ranked'. Three counts from different universes, not reconciled.

States NFL.com is the only official source and is used for spot verification of scheduled games and final scores, not bulk ingestion. States the canonical nflverse-data release assets were not reachable from the build sandbox (IR-01). Model inputs therefore cannot be treated as official.
Committed values do not reproduce on a fresh run (C08). verify_all.py passes on the committed files, so a PASS does not show reproducibility.
STR-16 is a deliberate leak control: 85.14% hit, +64.81% ROI, 31.29 luck-adjusted ROI. It is disqualified at G1. It must never be read as a strategy result.
STR-10 and STR-14 (prop combinations) have blank ROI cells. README.md states prop ROI 'Not here: no historical prop prices in the feed'. Blank is correct.

Nine other site folders are published from this repo (audit, dashboard, nfl-lines, nfl-research, research-desk, quant-lab, origination-lab, origination, skill-lab). Their numbers are not reconciled with each other.
